newsitem.title: USA: Minn. authority approves $29.375 mln of rev bonds.
newsitem.headline: Minn. authority approves $29.375 mln of rev bonds.

text.p: Minnesota Higher Education Facilities Authority has given final approval to issue $29.375 million of revenue bonds for new construction and renovation at St. John's University in Collegeville, Executive Director Luther Anderson said Thursday.
The negotiated sale of the bonds for St. John's was approved Wednesday and has been scheduled for July 8, Anderson said.
Dain Bosworth Inc and Dougherty Dawkins Inc will serve as underwriters, Anderson said.
Faegre & Benson of Minneapolis has been selected bond counsel and Springsted Inc of St. Paul serves as financial adviser, Anderson said.
St. John's plans construction of a new biological sciences building, fieldhouse and smaller student residence as well as renovation of a variety of buildings, Anderson said.
Anderson also said the University of St. Thomas plans to issue $11 million of variable rate bonds in late August or September.

St. Thomas plans to use $6.6 million of the proceeds for refinancing a variable rate issuance of a year ago and the remainder as partial funding for construction of a residence hall and parking structure, Anderson said.
As of June 1, the authority had approximately $264 million of revenue bonds outstanding, Anderson said.
